topic: how stores will scan stock during deliveries

options.A: Dedicated rugged handheld scanners, three per store

versions.option_text: A scanning app on the tablets and phones the stores already have

chain.speaker: Noor
chain.gist: Noor proposes dedicated rugged handheld scanners, three per store, for receiving deliveries.
chain.option: Dedicated rugged handheld scanners, three per store

chain.speaker: Noor
chain.gist: Noor says handhelds are faster, survive drops, last a full shift on battery, and warehouse staff already know how to use the older models.
chain.option: Dedicated rugged handheld scanners, three per store

chain.speaker: Greta
chain.gist: Greta reports the supplier now quotes $1,150 per unit with a ten-week lead time, so 36 units would cost $41,400 and arrive after the holiday peak.
chain.option: Dedicated rugged handheld scanners, three per store

chain.speaker: Henrik
chain.gist: Henrik says the app costs about $3,500 a year for 48 devices with no hardware spend, installs in ten minutes, and read 98.6 percent of barcodes on the first try in a two-store pilot in Leeds.
chain.option: A scanning app on the tablets and phones the stores already have

chain.speaker: Kofi
